senses.gloss:
IT.3.11.23 paktisthānam पक्तिस्थानम्
Place of digestion

IT.3.11.24 pakvāśayaḥ, pakvasthānam, pakvādhānam पक्वाशयः, पक्वस्थानम्, पक्वाधानम्
Large intestine
The primary functional area of vata dosha.

ITA-4.6.4 pakvāvasthā पक्वावस्था
Ripened stage of dosha
The transformative phase in the course of a disease or wound indicating a post-inflammatory or suppurative condition.

ITA-5.2.1.13 pakvāśayagatavātaḥ पक्वाशयगतवातः
Aggravation of vata in colon
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: borborygmi/gurgling intestinal sounds; colicky pain in abdomen; dysuria; difficulty in passing stool; borborygmi with distension; pain in sacroiliac region; constipation; urolithiasis; herniation; haemorrhoids; stiffness of sacroiliac region; stiffness of lower back.

ITA-4.2.20 pakvāśayasamuttharogaḥ पक्वाशयसमुत्थरोगः
Diseases of the lower gastrointestinal tract
Diseases and conditions which have their origin in the large intestinal tract such as piles and constipation.

ITA-5.72.14 Pakvāśayasthadūṣīviṣam पक्वाशयस्थ-दूषीविषम्
Cumulative poisoning with mild effect over time, poison lodged in intestines
Poisoning characterized by vāta pitta disorders; hair loss from head and body; individual resembling a bird with withered wings.

ITA-5.73.17 pakvāśayastha-rudhiraḥ पक्वाशयस्थ-रुधिरः
Accumulation of blood in the large intestine due to injury
A disorder characterized by heaviness; heaviness below the umbilicus; bleeding through orifices; pain; coldness; coldness in lower abdomen.

ITA-1.8.2.22 pakṣaḥ पक्षः
Subject under investigation
The context in which a cause-and-effect relationship has not been affirmed but is being examined or investigated.

ITA-3.1.21 pakṣaḥ पक्षः
Body half in the sagittal plane, limb

ITA-7.1.4.37 pakṣaḥ पक्षः
Time equivalent to one fortnight
Time equal to half of a lunar month or 15 days.

ITA-5.2.1.31 pakṣāghātaḥ/ pakṣavadhaḥ पक्षाघातः/पक्षवधः
Hemiplegia
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: hemiplegia/hemiparesis; loss of movement/ inability to move; impediment of speech/dysphasia; pain; contraction in a lower limb; contraction in an upper limb; pricking pain; sharp/acute pain; senselessness/ unconsciousness; dislocation of joint/flaccidity; loss of tactile sensation.

ITA-3.2.1.10 pakṣmavartma-sandhiḥ पक्ष्मवर्त्मसन्धिः
Junction of cilia with lid margin

ITA-5.66.92 pakṣmaśātaḥ पक्ष्मशातः
Loss of eyelashes, madarosis
A disorder characterized by itching along the margin of the eyelids; burning in eyelids; loss of eyelashes and burning sensation.

ITA-3.2.1.24 pakṣmāgram पक्ष्माग्रम्
Free ends of eyelashes

ITA-3.2.1.25 pakṣmāśayaḥ पक्ष्माशयः
Roots of eyelashes

ITA-5.66.91 pakṣmakopaḥ/ pakṣmoparodhaḥ पक्ष्मकोपः/पक्ष्मोपरोधः
Trichiasis, entropion
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: the development of sharp eyelashes; rough eyelashes; repeated rubbing of eyeball; vitiation of eye; releif on plucking/removal of eyelash; aversion to wind; aversion to sunlight; aversion to fire; constriction/spasm of the eyelids; downward-looking eyebrows; swelling of eyes due to irritation by sharp eyelash tips; burning sensation with sweating and restlessness; loss of eyelashes from their roots; distorted eyelashes; inward-turning eyelashes; redness of black cornea and white sclera.

ITA-2.6.26 pākaḥ पाकः
Digestion, metabolism, bio- transformation
The function of transformative factor.
